title: PatchTST: Channel-independent modelling improves multivariate forecasting accuracy on ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using PatchTST, a patch-based channel-independent transformer. On ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1, at horizon 336, Channel-independent modelling improves multivariate forecasting accuracy on ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1. PatchTST outperforms channel-mixing transformers by 32% MSE on 4 multivariate datasets. We discuss two limitations: Hyperparameters are tuned per-dataset, which advantages larger models that can absorb the added capacity. Attention weights are not analysed, leaving the interpretability claims unverified.
